MEZZOLOTH SELLBLADE CR 5
The hulking, beetle-like fiend moves in sharp twitches, its
pupilless eyes pivoting with ceaseless, nervous energy.
AC 18 (natural armor) Initiative +3 (13)
HP 75 (10d8 + 30) Size Medium (7 ft. tall)
Speed 40 ft. Type Fiend (Yugoloth)
MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE
STR 18 +4 +4 DEX 11 +0 +0 CON 16 +3 +3
INT 7 -2 -2 WIS 14 +2 +2 CHA 10 +0 +0
Skills Perception +5
Resistances Fire
Immunities Acid, Poison; Poisoned
Senses Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 15
Languages Abyssal, Infernal, Telepathy 60 ft.
Drives Advertise Services, Collect Loot, Escalate Conflict
XP 1,800 Proficiency Bonus +3
Traits
Conniving Resistance. The mezzoloth has Advantage on
Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects.
When the mezzoloth succeeds on a saving throw against
a spell, it can choose to fail. If it does, it can end the
spell’s effect at any time, with no action required.
Actions
Multiattack. The mezzoloth makes two attacks.
Spindletip Claws. Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13
(2d8 + 4) Slashing damage and the target is Grappled
(escape DC 15).
A creature Grappled in this way can attempt to escape as
a Bonus Action.
Weaverot Barb. Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 20/60 ft. Hit:
7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing plus 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage. Hit
or Miss: The mezzoloth can end one spell of Level 2 or
below affecting the target.
Toxic Emission. A cloud of stinging gas hisses from the
mezzoloth, forcing each creature within 10 feet of it to
make a CONSTITUTION SAVING THROW: DC 14. FAILURE: 18 (4d8)
Poison damage and the creature is Blinded until the end
of its next turn SUCCESS: Half damage.
Bonus Actions
Shred. One creature Grappled by the mezzoloth takes 9
(2d8) Slashing damage, or half as much if it is wearing
Heavy Armor.
Divergent Dark (Level 3 Spell). The mezzoloth creates two
5-foot diameter Spheres of Magical Darkness within 30
feet, then can teleport to an unoccupied space not
illuminated by Bright Light within 30 feet.
This darkness clears at the start of the mezzoloth’s next
turn, or if a creature within it takes or deals any damage.
